events.title: Evening Stargazing at the Bankhead Theatre
events.description: Livermore Amador Symphony will play a "Celestial Sounds" concert at the Bankhead Saturday evening May 31st. They would like us to set up out front for an intermission starting about 8:00-8:30. We would be looking at a first quarter moon in the daylight for this one. Then when the concert is over, a little starparty out front for until maybe 10 or so...I think

events.title: H2O open house
events.description:
Description


A trip for club members and the public to TVS’s dark observing site. Meet at the corner of Mines and Tesla Roads. The caravan to the site leaves at 6:30 pm sharp. Bring $3 for site admission.  This is also an opportunity for members who want access but have not completed site orientation to do so.
events.location: Meet at the corner of Mines and Tesla Roads

events.description: TVS Club meetings are open to all members and the public. See TVS newsletter www.trivalleystargazers.org for details on how to participate in the zoom video conference call.
